name: Conversation
description: A learner's conversation with the coach (DBU-07), oldest first, with a composer under it. As the learner (myMessages): all of it, or one homework's thread, and the switch for reply emails. As the coach (messagesAsCoach): one learner's, and a line when that learner gets no emails. Re-reads on the doorbell and after sending; reading marks the other side's messages read.
